process_and_save_game: process a single diplomacy game from sqlite database and save it as a json file to the output directory
process_game: process diplomacy game moves and messages from a database into a Game object with full order history
find_all_games: query the sqlite database to find all finished non-bot classic diplomacy games optionally filtered by press type
check_is_good_game: validate a diplomacy game passes basic quality checks including non-hold moves in turn 0 and at least 5 turns
move_row_to_order_str: convert a database move row from the moves archive table into a human-readable diplomacy order string
